met_analysis:
The Low Pressure area over North Myanmar and adjoining areas of southeast Bangladesh, Mizoram & Northeast Bay of Bengal now lies over North Myanmar and adjoining Mizoram-Tripura at 1730 hrs IST of today, 1st October 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea. It is likely to remain over the same region during next 12 hours.
The trough from Northeast Arabian sea to westcentral Arabian sea between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north coastal Tamil Nadu & neighbourhood lies over Coastal Tamil Nadu and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The north-south trough from North Interior Karnataka to Gulf of Mannar across interior Karnataka and Tamil Nadu at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood persists and now seen between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level with the trough aloft in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 26°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & adjoining Bihar persists and now seen between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level.
